mapper.select: SELECT id, temp, hum, threshold, alarm, ip, DATE_FORMAT(colltime, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS colltime FROM sht30_samples ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1000
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sht30_samples (temp, hum, threshold, alarm, ip, colltime) VALUES (#{temp}, #{hum}, #{threshold}, #{alarm}, #{ip}, #{colltime})
